title: Length of a joined configuration record
statement: Let $k,s$ be natural numbers, let $Q$ and $T$ be types, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine on input $x$, and let $\tau\in T$. If $w(n)$ denotes the number of binary digits of $n+1$, then the list obtained by joining the fields of the record formed from $s$, $c$, and $\tau$ has length $k(2s+1)+w(|x|)+k+4$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration with $k$ work tapes on input $x$
